181: Within it is the infinite treasure.
Within it, it is said, dwells the great Banker.
ਕਵਨੁ ਬਾਪਾਰੀ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਊਹਾ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Who is the trader who has credit there? ॥1॥
Rare is the one who trades in the jewel of the Name;
he takes the ambrosial food as his nourishment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I would dedicate my mind and body to his service.
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
What is the way by which the Lord is pleased?
I would fall at his feet, abandoning all sense of mine and yours.
ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ; ਜੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
Who is that humble one who can strike this bargain for me? ॥2॥
ਮਹਲੁ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ; ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
How can one attain the mansion of the Banker?
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
What is the way by which He calls one within?
ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹੁ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
You are the great Banker; You have millions of traders.
Who is the generous one who will take me and carry me to You? ॥3॥
Searching and searching, I have found my own true home.
The True Guru has shown me the priceless, true jewel.
When the Banker shows mercy and unites one with Himself,
says Nanak, it is through faith in the Guru. ॥4॥16॥85॥
Night and day, they remain in the love of the One.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
They know God to be always with them.
They have made the Name of their Lord and Master their daily practice.
They are satisfied and fulfilled by the Lord's Blessed Vision. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
Imbued with the Lord's love, their minds and bodies are rejuvenated,
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ; ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who have entered the sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Lord's lotus feet are the support of their souls.
They behold only the One, and obey His command.
There is only one trade and one business for them;
they know no other than the Formless Lord. ॥2॥
They are free of both pleasure and pain.
They remain ever unattached, united with the Lord and in the right way of life.
ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
They are seen among all, yet remain apart from all.
They focus their meditation on the Supreme Lord God. ॥3॥
How can I describe the glories of the saints?
ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
Their wisdom is unfathomable; I cannot know their extent.
O Supreme Lord God, please show mercy to me:
bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the saints. ॥4॥17॥86॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ; ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
You are my Companion, You are my Friend.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੀਤੁ ॥
You are my Beloved; I am in love with You.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ; ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
You are my honour, You are my ornament.
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ; ਨਿਮਖੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
Without You I cannot live even for a moment. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
You are my Darling, You are my breath of life.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are my Master, You are my Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਨਾ ॥
As You keep me, so I live.
ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਹੁ; ਸੋਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Whatever You say, that is what I do.
Wherever I look, there I see You dwelling.
With my tongue I chant Your Name, which makes one fearless. ॥2॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ; ਤੂੰ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
You are my nine treasures, You are my storehouse.
You are my joys and delights; You are the support of my mind.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੀਆ ॥
You are my glory; I am absorbed in You.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ; ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
You are my shelter; You are my support. ॥3॥
Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.
I have learnt Your secret from the Guru.
One in whom the True Guru has implanted the One and only Lord —
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੭॥
servant Nanak takes the support of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ॥4॥18॥87॥
182: (Maya) affects us through the expanse of pleasure and pain.
It affects us through births in heaven and hell.
It affects the rich, the poor, and those who behold their own glory.
It affects us as greed, the root of all disease. ॥1॥
Maya affects us in so many ways,
ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but the saints live under Your protection, O God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
It affects one intoxicated with self-conceit.
It affects one absorbed in children and spouse.
It affects us through elephants, horses and fine clothes.
It affects one drunk with the wine of beauty and youth. ॥2॥
It affects landowners, paupers and lovers of pleasure.
It affects us through the sweet sounds of songs in company.
It affects us through beds, palaces and adornments.
It affects us as the five demons, in the darkness (of attachment). ॥3॥
It affects one who does deeds entangled in ego.
It affects the householder and the renunciate alike.
It affects us through rituals, customs and caste.
ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥
It affects everything, except those imbued with the Lord's love. ॥4॥
ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ; ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
The Sovereign Lord King has cut the bonds of His saints;
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਿਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਈ ॥
Says Nanak, one who has obtained the dust of the feet of the saints —
Maya does not come near him. ॥5॥19॥88॥
The eyes are asleep in looking at others with evil intent.
The ears are asleep, listening to slanderous talk.
The tongue is asleep in greed for sweet tastes.
The mind is asleep, entranced by Maya. ॥1॥
ਇਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ; ਕੋਈ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
Rare is the one who stays awake in this house (of the body);
ਸਾਬਤੁ ਵਸਤੁ; ਓਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
he keeps his whole treasure intact. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All the companions (the senses) are intoxicated with their own pleasures;
ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ; ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
they take no care of their own home.
fall upon the deserted village (of the body). ॥2॥
ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
Neither father nor mother can save one from them;
ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
neither friend nor brother can save one from them.
They are not held back by wealth or cleverness.
Only in the holy company are those villains brought under control. ॥3॥
Have mercy on me, O Lord, Sustainer of the earth.
The dust of the feet of the saints is all treasure to me.
In the company of the True Guru, one's capital stays intact.
Nanak is awake in the love of the Supreme Lord God. ॥4॥
He alone is awake, to whom God is merciful.
ਇਹ ਪੂੰਜੀ; ਸਾਬਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨੦॥੮੯॥
His capital, wealth and property remain intact. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥20॥89॥
He under whose control are chiefs and kings,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
under whose control is the whole world,
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Offer your prayer to your True Guru;
He will resolve your affairs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
His court is the highest of all;
ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
His Name is the support of all His devotees.
The perfect Master is pervading all;
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਨੀ ॥੨॥
His glory is manifest in each and every heart. ॥2॥
Remembering Him, the house of pain is demolished.
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਜਮੁ. ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
Remembering Him, the Messenger of Death does not touch one.
Remembering Him, the dry branches become green again.
183: Remembering Him, sinking stones are carried across. ॥3॥
Forever hail the society of the saints.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the support of the breath of life of His humble servants.
Says Nanak, He has heard my prayer;
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੦॥
by the grace of the saints, I dwell in the Name. ॥4॥21॥90॥
By the Blessed Vision of the True Guru, the fire (of craving) is put out.
Meeting the True Guru, ego is subdued.
In the company of the True Guru, the mind does not waver.
The Guru-facing one speaks the ambrosial Word. ॥1॥
ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਜਾ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
The whole world appears true, when one is imbued with the True One.
ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am cooled and soothed, having come to know God through the Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By the grace of the saint (Guru), one chants the Lord's Name.
By the grace of the saint, one sings the Lord's praises.
By the grace of the saint, all pain is erased.
By the grace of the saint, one is released from bondage. ॥2॥
ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਮਿਟੇ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ॥
By the kindness of the saint, attachment and doubt are dispelled.
Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy is the essence of all religion.
When the Holy are kind and compassionate, the Lord of the Universe is too.
This soul of mine is with the Holy. ॥3॥
When I meditate on the merciful Lord, the treasure of mercy,
then I obtain a seat in the holy company.
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
God has shown mercy to me, worthless as I am;
O Nanak, in the holy company I have taken up the Name. ॥4॥22॥91॥
Those who meditate on the Lord God in the holy company,
to whom the Guru has given the mantra of the Name alone,
renouncing pride, have become free of hate.
Twenty-four hours a day, worship the Guru's feet. ॥1॥
Now my evil, alien intellect is gone,
ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਣਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
since I heard the Lord's praises with my ears. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The treasure of poise, peace and bliss —
the Protector Lord saves them in the end.
Their pain, suffering, fear and doubt are dispelled.
In His grace, He has ended their coming and going. ॥2॥
He Himself sees, speaks and hears all.
ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
O mind, meditate on Him who is always with you.
By the saint's grace, the light has dawned;
the One Lord, the Treasure of virtue, is pervading everywhere. ॥3॥
Pure are those who speak, and sanctified are those who listen,
who sing the praises of the Lord of the Universe day after day.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Says Nanak, when You show Your mercy to someone,
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੨॥
all the efforts of that humble being are fulfilled. ॥4॥23॥92॥
Breaking one's bonds, (the Guru) inspires one to chant the Lord's Name.
The mind is fixed in true meditation.
Anguish is erased, and one dwells in peace.
Such a Giver is the True Guru said to be. ॥1॥
He alone is the Giver of peace, who inspires one to chant the Name,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and in His mercy unites one with Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
The one to whom the Lord is merciful, He Himself unites (with the Guru),
and he obtains all treasures from the Guru.
Renouncing self-conceit, his coming and going are ended.
In the company of the Holy, he recognises the Supreme Lord God. ॥2॥
God has become merciful to His humble servant;
184: the One Lord of the world is the support of His servant.
He loves the One Lord; his mind is in love with the One.
ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
The Lord's Name is all treasures to His servant. ॥3॥
One who is in love with the Supreme Lord God —
his actions are pure, and his way of life is true.
The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness.
Nanak's God is the farthest of the far, infinite. ॥4॥24॥93॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਤਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
The one in whose mind He dwells is carried across,
the one who receives Him by His grace.
ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ; ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
No pain, disease or fear afflicts him,
for he meditates on the Lord's Ambrosial Name in his heart. ॥1॥
Meditate on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ; ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The merciful Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes;
He cherishes all beings and creatures.
He is inaccessible, unfathomable, forever infinite.
Remember Him, O mind, through the teaching of the Perfect Guru. ॥2॥
Serving Him, all treasures are obtained.
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ; ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Service to Him never goes in vain.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
Forever and ever, sing the praises of the Lord. ॥3॥
Have mercy on me, O God, Searcher of hearts,
Treasure of peace, unseen Lord and Master.
All beings and creatures seek Your sanctuary.
O Nanak, the Name is obtained, and that is glory. ॥4॥25॥94॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
He in whose hands is the way of life of all beings —
remember Him, the Master of the masterless.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ; ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
When God comes to mind, all pain departs.
ਭੈ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
All fears are dispelled through the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ; ਭਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਾ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥
Why do you fear anything other than the Lord?
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ; ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Forgetting the Lord, why do you think you are at peace? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He who has upheld the many earths and skies,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
whose blessings no one can erase —
remembering, remembering God, one becomes fearless. ॥2॥
Twenty-four hours a day, remember God's Name;
it is bathing at many places of pilgrimage.
If you seek the sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God,
ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੰਕ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
millions of stains shall be erased in an instant. ॥3॥
The Perfect King depends on no one.
God's servant has true faith in Him.
Through the Perfect Guru, He gives His hand and protects them.
O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God is all-powerful. ॥4॥26॥95॥
By the Guru's grace, my mind is attached to the Name.
Asleep for so many births, it has now awakened.
One utters the ambrosial praises and the Word of God,
when one receives the sublime teaching of the Perfect Guru. ॥1॥
Remembering God, I have found all comforts.
ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Within my home and outside, there is peace and poise all around. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I have recognised the One who created me.
In His mercy, God Himself has united me with Himself.
Taking me by the arm, He has made me His own.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ; ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੨॥
I ever chant and meditate on the discourse of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥2॥
Mantras, magic charms, medicines and acts of atonement —
185: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the support of soul and breath.
Imbued with the Lord's love, he has obtained the true wealth.
In the company of the Holy, he crosses over the treacherous (world-ocean). ॥3॥
Sit in peace, O saints and friends, as one family.
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਓ; ਜਾ ਕਾ. ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
They have earned the wealth of the Lord, which is beyond measure.
The Guru gives it to the one who is destined to receive it.
O Nanak, no one goes away empty-handed. ॥4॥27॥96॥
The hands become sanctified at once,
and the entanglements of Maya are dispelled.
With your tongue, ever dwell on the praises of the Lord,
and you shall find peace, O my brother and friend. ॥1॥
With pen, ink and paper, write
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Name of the Lord, the ambrosial Word of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By this deed, your sins shall depart.
Remembering the Lord, you shall not be struck by Death.
ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ; ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
The messengers of the Righteous Judge shall not even look at you.
Engrossed in Maya, nothing shall entice you. ॥2॥
You shall be saved, and through you the world shall be saved,
if you chant the Name of the One Universal Lord.
Practise this yourself, and teach it to others;
enshrine the Lord's Name in your heart. ॥3॥
One who has this treasure written on his forehead —
that person meditates on the Lord God.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Twenty-four hours a day, he sings the praises of the Lord, Har, Har.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੭॥
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to him. ॥4॥28॥97॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Gauri Guareri · Chaupade Dupade · Guru Arjan
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
What belongs to others, we claim as our own.
ਜੋ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਨ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
Our minds are engrossed in what we must abandon and leave behind. ॥1॥
Tell me, how can we meet the Lord of the world,
ਜੋ ਬਿਬਰਜਤ; ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
when we love what is forbidden? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਝੂਠੁ ਬਾਤ; ਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
We take what is false to be true;
ਸਤਿ ਹੋਵਨੁ; ਮਨਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ. ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
what is certain to happen (death) does not touch our minds at all. ॥2॥
We take the crooked path and walk the wrong way;
leaving the straight way, we weave the weave backwards. ॥3॥
ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ; ਖਸਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
God is the Master of both sides.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੮॥
Whom He unites with Himself, O Nanak, is liberated. ॥4॥29॥98॥
In this Dark Age, (husband and wife) come together through past destiny.
As long as His command allows, they enjoy their pleasures. ॥1॥
By burning oneself, the Beloved is not obtained;
ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ; ਸਤੀ ਉਠਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
it is (wrongly hoping for) reunion through deeds that the widow rises and burns herself as a sati. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Copying others, through stubbornness of mind, she is burnt;
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ. ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
she does not obtain the company of her Beloved, and wanders through many births. ॥2॥
With good conduct and self-discipline, she obeys her husband's command;
ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਕਉ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
that woman shall not suffer pain at the hands of the Messenger of Death. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Says Nanak, she who looks upon her husband as her lord (as the devotee looks upon God) —
blessed is that true sati; she is accepted in the court of the Lord. ॥4॥30॥99॥
I am wealthy and fortunate through the True Name;
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I sing the praises of the Lord with natural ease and love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
186: ਪੀਊ ਦਾਦੇ ਕਾ; ਖੋਲਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥
When I opened and beheld the treasure of my father and grandfather (the Gurus),
my mind became filled with treasure. ॥1॥
ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ; ਜਾ ਕਾ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਮੋਲੁ ॥
the storehouses are overflowing, inexhaustible and immeasurable. ॥2॥
Those who join together, O brothers, to eat and spend it,
find that it never runs short, but keeps increasing. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
Says Nanak, one who has such destiny written on his forehead
becomes a sharer in this treasure. ॥4॥31॥100॥
ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਮਰਤੇ; ਜਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
We die of fear as long as we think Him far away.
Fear is gone when we see Him pervading everywhere. ॥1॥
I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.
ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He will not abandon me; He will surely carry me across. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ; ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਬ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Pain, disease and sorrow come when one forgets the Name.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
There is lasting bliss when one sings the Lord's praises. ॥2॥
Do not call anyone good or bad (in slander or flattery).
Renounce pride, and grasp the Lord's feet. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, remember the Guru's mantra,
and you shall find peace at the True Court. ॥4॥32॥101॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ; ਸਾਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਮੀਆ ॥
One whose Friend and Companion is the all-pervading Lord —
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਕਮੀਆ ॥੧॥
tell me, what does that person lack? ॥1॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
One who has fallen in love with the Lord of the Universe —
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
his pain, suffering and doubt run away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ. ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਹੈ ਆਇਓ ॥
One who has come to enjoy the taste of the Lord's essence
is not attracted to any other pleasures. ॥2॥
One whose word is accepted in the Lord's court —
ਸੋ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ; ਨਦਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਵੈ ਤਲੈ ॥੩॥
why should he care about anyone else? ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who belongs to Him, to whom everything belongs —
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੧੦੨॥
O Nanak, he finds lasting peace. ॥4॥33॥102॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
One who looks upon pain and pleasure alike —
The Lord's holy one abides in poise and bliss;
he remains obedient to the Lord, Har, Har, the King. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
One in whose mind the carefree Lord comes to dwell —
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
One whose mind has been rid of doubt —
ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਡਰੁ ਜਮਾ ॥੩॥
he has no fear of death at all. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
One whose heart the Guru has filled with the Name —
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੧੦੩॥
says Nanak, all treasures are his. ॥4॥34॥103॥
ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਕਾ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
The Lord of unfathomable form has His place in the mind.
By the Guru's grace, only a rare few come to know this. ॥1॥
The ambrosial springs of the discourse of poise —
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲੈ ਭੁੰਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the one who is destined to receive them drinks of them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The unstruck melody of the Word makes that place wondrous;
the Lord of the world Himself is fascinated by its melody. ॥2॥
There are countless arenas of poise there,
where the saints dwell in the company of the Supreme Lord God. ॥3॥
There is infinite joy, and no sorrow or duality.
ਸੋ ਘਰੁ; ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੧੦੪॥
The Guru has blessed Nanak with that home. ॥4॥35॥104॥
Which form of Yours should I worship?
What Yoga should I practise to discipline the body? ॥1॥
187: ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨੁ; ਜੋ ਤੁਝੁ ਲੈ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
What virtue of Yours should I sing?
What words should I speak to please the Supreme Lord God? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
What worship of You should I perform?
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਉ ॥੨॥
What is the way by which I may cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ॥2॥
What is that penance by which one becomes a true penitent?
ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
What is that Name by which the filth of ego is washed away? ॥3॥
ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਗਲ ਘਾਲ ॥
Singing His praises, worship, spiritual wisdom, meditation — O Nanak, all these efforts are fruitful
ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥
for the one who, by His grace, meets the merciful True Guru. ॥4॥
ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਗੁਨੁ; ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Only he has truly praised Him, only he has known God,
ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੇਇ; ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੩੬॥੧੦੫॥
whose prayer the Giver of peace accepts. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥36॥105॥
ਆਪਨ ਤਨੁ ਨਹੀ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਗਰਬਾ ॥
The body you are so proud of does not belong to you.
Power, property and wealth are not yours. ॥1॥
They are not yours, so why do you cling to them?
ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only the Name is yours; it is received from the True Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Children, spouse and siblings are not yours.
ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ; ਆਪ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Dear friends, father and mother are not yours. ॥2॥
Gold, silver and money are not yours.
Fine horses and magnificent elephants are of no use to you. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Says Nanak, the one whom the Guru forgives and unites with the Lord —
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੧੦੬॥
everything belongs to him, to whom the Lord King belongs. ॥4॥37॥106॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਊਪਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
The Guru's feet are upon my forehead,
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਗਲੇ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
and so all my pains are gone. ॥1॥
I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.
ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਿ; ਪਰਮ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Understanding my own self, I enjoy supreme bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਚਰਣ ਰੇਣੁ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
One whose face has touched the dust of the Guru's feet
has renounced all his egotistic intellect. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਲਗੋ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
The Guru's Word seems sweet to my mind;
through it, I behold the Supreme Lord God. ॥3॥
The Guru is the Giver of peace; the Guru is the Creator.
O Nanak, the Guru is the support of soul and breath. ॥4॥38॥107॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਆਹਿ ॥
O my mind, long for Him
ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
Make the Lord your Beloved, O my friend, my mind;
ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਦ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
keep Him, the support of your breath of life, ever in your consciousness. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਿ ॥
the Primal Being, the infinite Divine Lord. ॥2॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ; ਮਨ ਕਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਸਾ ॥
Place your hopes in Him, O mind,
in whom all have trusted from the very beginning, throughout the ages. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Loving Him, one finds lasting peace;
meeting the Guru, Nanak sings His praises. ॥4॥39॥108॥
Whatever my Friend does, I accept.
My Friend's actions are pleasing to me as comfort. ॥1॥
In my mind and heart is this one support:
ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ; ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He whose doing it all is, is my Friend. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By the Guru's grace, I am in love with Him. ॥2॥
My Friend knows the hearts of all.
He is the all-powerful Being, the Supreme Lord God, the Master. ॥3॥
I am Your servant; You are my Lord and Master.
188: O God, Nanak's honour and greatness are Yours. ॥4॥40॥109॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ. ਤੁਮ ਭਏ; ਸਮਰਥ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
Those whom You support, O all-powerful Lord,
are not touched by any stain. ॥1॥
ਮਾਧਉ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
O Lord of Maya, those who place their hope in You
ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
have nothing to do with the world. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those in whose hearts their Lord and Master dwells
are not touched by any anxiety. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਤੁਮ ਦੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੀਰ ॥
Those whom You give courage, O God —
ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੩॥
pain does not come near them. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਮੈ. ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Says Nanak, I have found that Guru
who has shown me the Perfect Supreme Lord God. ॥4॥41॥110॥
This human body, so hard to obtain, is obtained by great good fortune.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ; ਤੇ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
Those who do not chant the Name are destroyers of their own souls. ॥1॥
ਮਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ; ਜਿਨਾ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
Why should they not die, who forget the Lord?
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ; ਜੀਵਨ ਕਉਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name, of what use is life? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Eating, drinking, playing, laughing and showing off —
of what use are the ornaments decorating a corpse? ॥2॥
Those who do not listen to the praises of the Lord of supreme bliss
ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ; ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਤੇ ਮੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
are worse than beasts, birds and creeping creatures. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, the one in whom the Guru has implanted the mantra —
the Name alone is absorbed in his heart. ॥4॥42॥111॥
ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ; ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਪ ॥
All these relationships are false, in name only. ॥1॥
Why are you babbling and crying out, you fool?
ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By His command and through past association, you have come into the world. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
There is one clay, and one light;
there is one breath; why should anyone weep for anyone? ॥2॥
but this soul is not subject to death. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, those whose doors the Guru has opened
are liberated, and all the illusions of doubt are dispelled. ॥4॥43॥112॥
Those who appear to be the great and mighty
are afflicted by the disease of anxiety. ॥1॥
Who is great by the greatness of Maya?
ਸੋ ਵਡਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He alone is great, who is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The landlord fights over his land every day.
He leaves it behind and departs, but his craving is not quenched. ॥2॥
Says Nanak, this is the essence I have reflected upon:
without meditating on the Lord, there is no release. ॥3॥44॥113॥
Perfect is the path, perfect the cleansing bath;
everything is perfect, when the Name is in the heart. ॥1॥
One's honour remains perfectly intact when the Perfect One preserves it,
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਜਨ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for His servant has sought the sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Perfect is the peace, perfect the contentment;
perfect the penance, perfect the kingship and the Yoga. ॥2॥
On the Lord's path, sinners are purified.
Perfect is their glory, perfect their dealings with the world. ॥3॥
The Creator Lord ever dwells with him,
says Nanak, (who has met) my Perfect True Guru. ॥4॥45॥114॥
ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ; ਮਿਟੇ ਅਘ ਕੋਟ ॥
Through the dust of the feet of the saint, millions of sins are erased.
189: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥
By the saint's grace, one is released from birth and death. ॥1॥
The Blessed Vision of the saint is the perfect cleansing bath.
ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the saint's kindness, one chants the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the company of the saint, ego is erased,
and the One Universal Lord is seen everywhere. ॥2॥
When the saint is pleased, the five (passions) are brought under control,
and one gathers the Ambrosial Name in the heart. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮ ॥
Says Nanak, one who has perfect destiny
touches the feet of the Holy. ॥4॥46॥115॥
Meditating on the Lord's praises, the lotus (of the heart) blossoms.
Remembering the Lord, all fear is dispelled. ॥1॥
ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Perfect is that intellect by which one sings the Lord's praises;
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by great good fortune, one finds the company of the Holy. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the company of the Holy, the treasure of the Name is obtained.
In the company of the Holy, all one's works are fulfilled. ॥2॥
Through devotion to the Lord, one's life is approved.
By the Guru's grace, one chants the Name. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, that humble one is accepted
in whose heart the Lord God dwells. ॥4॥47॥116॥
ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
One whose mind is imbued with the One Lord
He sees no one other than the Lord of the Universe,
the Creator, the Doer, the Cause of causes. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਮੁਖਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
One who works with his mind and chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har, with his mouth
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਇਤ ਉਤ. ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੨॥
does not waver, here or hereafter. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ; ਸੋ ਸਚ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
One who has the wealth of the Lord is the true banker;
the Perfect Guru has established his credit. ॥3॥
He has met the Lord King, the Life of all;
says Nanak, he has attained the supreme state. ॥4॥48॥117॥
The Name is the support of the breath of life of His devotees.
The Name is their wealth, the Name their trade. ॥1॥
Through the greatness of the Name, His humble servant obtains glory,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the one to whom He Himself, in His mercy, grants it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Name is the home of peace for His devotees.
Imbued with the Name, His devotees are approved. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
The Name of the Lord is the support of His humble servants.
With each and every breath, they remember the Name. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, one who has perfect destiny —
his mind is attached to the Name. ॥4॥49॥118॥
By the saint's grace, I have meditated on the Lord's Name;
since then, my restless mind has been satisfied. ॥1॥
Singing His praises, I have found the home of peace.
ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ; ਮੇਰੀ ਹਤੀ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My struggles are over, and the demon (of craving) is slain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Worshipping the lotus feet of the Lord God,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ; ਮਿਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
and remembering the Lord, my anxiety is gone. ॥2॥
ਸਭ ਤਜਿ ਅਨਾਥੁ; ਏਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
Renouncing all else, I, the orphan, have come to the sanctuary of the One;
then, with ease, I attained the highest place. ॥3॥
Pain, suffering, doubt and fear have run away.
The Creator Lord dwells in Nanak's mind. ॥4॥50॥119॥
ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਟਹਲ; ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
With my hands I do His service, and with my tongue I sing His praises;
190: and with my feet I walk on the path of my Lord and Master. ॥1॥
Blessed is this time, the time to remember Him.
ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਭੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remembering the Name, one crosses over the ocean of fear. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
With your eyes, behold the Blessed Vision of the saints.
Inscribe the Imperishable God within your mind. ॥2॥
Go to the Holy and listen to the Lord's praises,
and the fear of birth and death shall be dispelled. ॥3॥
Enshrine the lotus feet of your Lord and Master in your heart.
O Nanak, this human body is so hard to obtain; let it be saved. ॥4॥51॥120॥
The one upon whom He showers His mercy —
that humble being chants the Name with his tongue. ॥1॥
Forgetting the Lord, one is gripped by anxiety and pain.
ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remembering the Name, doubt and fear run away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
One who listens to the Lord's praises and sings the Lord's praises —
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਦੂਖੁ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
pain does not even come near him. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਰਤ; ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
Working for the Lord, His humble servant looks beautiful;
ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ. ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
the fire of Maya does not touch him. ॥3॥
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Within his mind, body and mouth is the Name of the merciful Lord;
O Nanak, he has renounced all other entanglements. ॥4॥52॥121॥
Give up your cleverness and great shrewdness,
and take the support of the Perfect Guru. ॥1॥
ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ; ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Pain is gone, and one finds peace singing the Lord's praises,
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
meeting the Perfect Guru and lovingly attuning oneself (to the Lord). ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
The Guru has given me the mantra of the Lord's Name;
my worries are gone, and my anxiety is lifted. ॥2॥
Meeting the merciful Guru, I am in bliss.
In His mercy, He has cut away the noose of death. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Guru;
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ; ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫੩॥੧੨੨॥
Maya shall never afflict me again. ॥4॥53॥122॥
The Perfect Guru Himself has saved me.
The self-willed are afflicted with misery. ॥1॥
Remember the Guru, the Guru, O my friends,
and your faces shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Enshrine the feet of the Guru in your heart;
your pains, enemies and the demon (of Maya) shall be destroyed. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
The Guru's Word is your companion and helper.
All beings become kind to you, O brother. ॥3॥
When the Perfect Guru granted His grace,
says Nanak, I was completely fulfilled. ॥4॥54॥123॥
He eats many delicacies, like a beast;
he is bound by the rope of attachment, like a thief. ॥1॥
The body without the company of the Holy is a corpse.
ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ; ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖ ਖੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It comes and goes in reincarnation, and is wasted away by pain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
but he is like a scarecrow in the field, scaring the animals away. ॥2॥
All bodies are of some use,
but the mortal who does not chant the Name is useless. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Says Nanak, those to whom the Lord is merciful
join the holy company and meditate on the Lord of the world. ॥4॥55॥124॥
